@graph.name: @nymrel/machine-trust
@graph.description: A TypeScript library and CLI that generates and audits machine-readable web evidence.
@graph.featureList: Schema.org JSON-LD generation from explicit entity relationships, llms.txt and llms-full.txt generation, AI-search crawler policy generation, Answer-first summary checks, Structured-data and rendered-copy parity checks, Deterministic audit scorecards

acceptedAnswer.text: It checks structured data, machine-readable indexes, crawler rules, answer-first summaries, and rendered-copy parity against the configuration supplied by the operator.

mainEntity.name: Does Machine Trust invent an ownership hierarchy?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Generic sites receive no corporate parent. Explicit caller-supplied relationships are validated, and built or partner properties may credit Nymrel by canonical creator reference.
